filter_note: V1 set (7) + market briefing + AI news; Today window = Fri Nov 13 (after the morning run) – Mon Nov 16 morning PT (weekend; items already on the Nov 10–13 briefs not re-led)

market_briefing.lede: AI-native CRMs are now going directly after Salesforce installs: Lightfield launched an enterprise edition with a 30-day migration and a buy-out of existing CRM contracts, and Dreamteam raised $53M for a CRM that captures email and meetings automatically and runs agents on top.

bullets.text: Nov 16: Lightfield for Enterprise adds SSO, SCIM, per-object and per-record permissions, and custom objects. Agents, automations and API keys act with the permissions of the person they act for, and each AI-filled field can be set to Off, Suggest or Auto. Lightfield's own team migrates customers off Salesforce in 30 days or less (average six days), keeps two-way Salesforce sync during the move, credits the months left on a Salesforce or HubSpot contract, and does not charge until the agreed scope is delivered.

Nov 16: Dreamteam, founded by former Freshworks executives, raised $53M (seed led by Together Fund, Series A led by Accel). Its CRM builds a shared “Company Brain” from emails and meetings, and four built-in agents research prospects, draft follow-ups, flag deal risk and configure workflows. The company reports 100+ customers in three months of selling, including a Salesforce replacement at DMS Health.

Nov 16: Deloitte Digital launched Converge Sales, pre-built sector-specific agents that work inside a client's existing systems to research prospects, answer inbound buyers, keep deal next steps current and reconcile pipeline against forecast, with human review built in.

biggest_ai_news.title: NVIDIA leadership fight heads into Nov 17 earnings
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 15–16: Treasury Secretary Bessent urged an outside CEO and questioned NVIDIA's export-control compliance; the FT reported Huang has discussed returning, and Altimeter and Atreides asked the board to consider all options. NVIDIA says it is selecting a search firm and has not engaged candidates.

biggest_ai_news.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for agent purchases
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 13 (after the Friday brief): dots agents for US ChatGPT Pro users can pay with a network token instead of card details, with biometric approval of every purchase (Amex, Mastercard, Visa). OpenAI also published a Commerce Partner Playbook covering Web Bot Auth and WebMCP.

biggest_ai_news.title: Anthropic shortens its vulnerability disclosure window to 30 days
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 16: for vulnerabilities reported from Jan 1, 2027, high and critical issues get 30 days (down from 90) and others 45, because models now rediscover the same bugs faster.

biggest_ai_news.title: Anthropic IPO week
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 16: pricing is expected the evening of Nov 18 and Nasdaq trading Nov 19 as ANT (825M shares at $70–$78). Tom's Hardware reports Anthropic told investors Claude Mythos Preview did the AMD MI355X software bring-up in about three days.

what_changed.title: Lightfield for Enterprise: Salesforce migration in 30 days and CRM contract buy-out
what_changed.body: Nov 16: enterprise edition with SAML/OIDC SSO, SCIM, enforced MFA, per-object and per-record permissions, custom objects and multiple pipelines; agents and scoped API keys inherit the acting user's permissions; REST API, MCP server and CLI expose everything the app does. Lightfield runs each migration (average six days), keeps two-way Salesforce sync until cutover, credits remaining months on Salesforce, HubSpot or other CRM contracts, and bills only after the agreed scope ships.

what_changed.title: Dreamteam raises $53M for an AI-native CRM
what_changed.body: Nov 16: seed (Together Fund) and Series A (Accel) with Premji Invest; round sizes and valuation not disclosed. Four agents work from a shared Company Brain built from email and meetings; 100+ customers in 13 countries; target of eight-figure revenue by end of 2027.

what_changed.title: Deloitte Digital launches Converge Sales and Converge Marketing agent suites
what_changed.body: Nov 16: Converge Front Office starts with Marketing (research, build, execution and monitor agents) and Sales (pre-built sector agents for prospect research, inbound response and time-to-quote, deal hygiene and pipeline-to-forecast reconciliation), deployed on clients' existing software with Deloitte engineers.

what_changed.title: ChatGPT Wallet lets agents complete purchases
what_changed.body: Nov 13: rolling out to US ChatGPT Pro users in dots; each purchase needs biometric approval, payment uses a network token, and OpenAI expects pre-approved spending limits later. Merchants are asked to allow signed agent requests (Web Bot Auth) and can add WebMCP tools.

quiet_note: No new launch, funding, M&A or pricing from Salesforce, Gong, Clay, Nooks, Outreach, Salesloft or Monaco dated Nov 13 (after the morning run) through Nov 16. Weekend coverage of Agentforce Coworker (185,000 users), Clay's $7.1B valuation, Nooks' $500M and Outreach Org Context repeats announcements from Oct 28–Nov 10. Salesloft newsroom still tops out at Oct 27; Clay's latest changelog roundup is Nov 9.

market_direction.label: Accelerating (AI-native CRMs targeting Salesforce installs)
market_direction.text: Lightfield's enterprise edition with contract buy-out and Dreamteam's $53M (both Nov 16) pitch replacing the system of record, not adding to it.

market_direction.label: Accelerating (agents bound to the acting user's permissions)
market_direction.text: Lightfield agents and API keys inherit the user's permissions (Nov 16); ChatGPT Wallet requires approval of each purchase (Nov 13).

market_direction.label: New (agents that pay)
market_direction.text: ChatGPT Wallet gives agents tokenized card payments, with a merchant playbook for letting agents through (Nov 13).

market_direction.label: Steady (core watchlist)
market_direction.text: No new launches from the seven tracked companies over the weekend.

watch.title: NVIDIA Q3 results Nov 17 under an interim CEO; Anthropic prices Nov 18 and trades Nov 19; Claude Data default-on Nov 19; Salesforce Hunter and Coworker November GA items
watch.body: NVIDIA reports Tuesday amid the campaign for Huang's return. Anthropic is expected to price Wednesday evening and trade Thursday, the same day Claude Data turns on by default for Enterprise orgs. Salesforce listed Hunter and Coworker in Teams and desktop/mobile apps as November GA; neither has been announced as GA yet.

interpretation.fact: Nov 16 Lightfield launched Lightfield for Enterprise with a 30-day Salesforce migration and CRM contract buy-out. Nov 16 Dreamteam announced $53M for an AI-native CRM. Nov 16 Deloitte Digital launched Converge Sales and Converge Marketing. Nov 13 OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet. Nov 15–16 Bessent called for an outside NVIDIA CEO while investors and the FT reported a push for Huang's return. Nov 16 Anthropic shortened its disclosure windows to 30/45 days from Jan 1, 2027. None of the seven core watchlist companies announced a new launch, funding, M&A or pricing change Nov 13–16.
interpretation.interpretation: Switching cost is becoming the main battleground in CRM: newer vendors are absorbing migration labor and existing contract terms, the two things that kept large teams on Salesforce. Agent permissions that mirror the acting user, as in Lightfield and ChatGPT Wallet, are turning into a baseline expectation for any agent that writes to records or spends money.
